title: Perfect tour! It was just...
text: Perfect tour! It was just the right amount of time, with a great variety of food and interesting facts. Our guide Dasha was interesting and knowledgeable about the history of Barcelona and Catalonia! She also gave us some restaurant recommendations for after.

title: Last minute Pisa visit
text: Pisa was much more than we expected beyond the tower.   Viator was the only place we could get tickets for the next day online - which was fantastic. Only thing that could have been better was details on where exactly to go to use the tickets.so we asked someone there where to go. For us it was right at base of the tower and at door of the cathedral.  No need for printed tickets.  Everything came digitally so need for anything beyond our phone

title: Great food and great time
text: We learned so much about history and culture on this tour and all the food stops were amazing! Sophia was a great guide and had so much knowledge. It felt like you were getting info from a person who was passionate about where she lived and wanted to share it with you. It was a great way to start our trip in Catalonia!
author: rachelgJ5028AN

title: Martina was an excellent...
text:
Martina was an excellent guide, leading us through markets and neighborhoods in Barcelona that we might never have discovered on our own. In addition to the delicious tastings, she pointed out notable landmarks and shared insights into the area’s history and culture. Her knowledge, enthusiasm, and friendly personality made the experience both educational and enjoyable. We highly recommend this tour to anyone looking to experience Barcelona beyond the typical tourist attractions.

One bit of advice - the meeting location was shown as “meet at Liceu, Barcelona; guide will be by “Mosaico di Miro”
author: Christine_W
